decisions: Direct handler invocation from router.stack instead of app.handle() — Express app.handle requires real IncomingMessage/ServerResponse objects, mock req/res don't route properly
getHandlers() extracts middleware+handler chain from route layers by matching method+path in router.stack — works with parameterized routes using Express raw path patterns
vi.hoisted for shared mock functions needing per-test configurability (mockGetAuthInfo, mockAuditLog) — vitest.mocks factory is scope-isolated so hoisted vars bridge the gap
vi.mock paths must match routes.ts perspective, not test file perspective — ../.. from src/modules/auth/__tests__/ != ../.. from src/modules/auth/
failedAttempts: app.handle(req, res) with mock req/res — Express doesn't route requests through mock objects; handlers never execute
vi.hoisted with destructured variables in mock factory — worked after fixing relative paths (need ../../../ from __tests__/, not ../../)
uncertainties: studio-prisma/dist stub may affect tsc type check — needed for vitest module resolution but causes prisma:{} cascade errors
constraintsDiscovered: express-rate-limit requires req.get() — mock req must provide this or rate-limit middleware crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined'
Success handler paths call res.json() without res.status() (Express defaults to 200) — tests must check json() not status() for success cases
